title: RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category Admit Card 2026
postName: Ministerial & Isolated Categories (MI) – CBT / Stage Admit Card
vacancyDetails: Admit card / city details for RRB Ministerial and Isolated Category posts as per latest CEN
qualification: Post-wise (stenographer, clerk, teacher, etc.) as per RRB MI notification
ageLimit: As per RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category CEN
selectionProcess: CBT → Skill Test / Performance Test (post-wise) → DV → Medical
documentsRequired: Registration number and password/DOB; printed e-call letter; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit regional RRB website or rrbcdg.gov.in
2. Open Ministerial & Isolated Category Admit Card / City Slip link
3. Login with Registration Number and DOB
4. Download e-Call Letter
5. Appear as per centre and shift on hall ticket
shortDescription: RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category Admit Card 2026 – download CBT/hall ticket from regional RRB websites when link is active.
content:
Railway Recruitment Boards issue admit cards for Ministerial & Isolated Categories recruitment through regional portals.

Candidates should check their applied RRB website for city intimation and e-Call Letter, verify exam date/shift/centre, and carry a printed admit card with original photo ID on the day of CBT or skill test.
